home.hero_title: Tropical Ecology and Natural Resource Management Laboratory
home.hero_subtitle: Preserving biodiversity and managing natural resources through ecological research and sustainable practices.
home.about_text: The TENRM Lab is dedicated to addressing the complex challenges in tropical ecology and natural resource management. Our multi-disciplinary team of researchers and scientists works together to develop innovative solutions that promote conservation, sustainability, and resilience in tropical ecosystems.

research.title: Research Areas & Projects
research.intro: Our laboratory focuses on cutting-edge research in tropical ecology and natural resource management. We aim to bridge the gap between ecological theory and practical, sustainable conservation practices.
